correctness.rationale: Proof: complete recursive perfect-matching search by least uncovered vertex yields 33; pair-complement enumeration yields 20 one-factorizations; switches are exactly components of each bichromatic two-factor, 27 edges; the graph has 16+4 components; an explicit bijection in certificate.json maps all 24 nonstar edges bijectively onto GP(8,3). Separate edge-by-edge three-coloring enumeration independently returns the 20 vertices and 27 edge set. Both embedded code files and the actual certificate were executed and verified. This is a finite fixed-graph classification, not infinite extrapolation.

originality.rationale: Prior Kempe switching and general class counts, including the 2021 16-vertex bipartite census, are credited; novelty is restricted to the complete GP(8,3) twenty-vertex color-permutation quotient adjacency graph and its explicit self-isomorphism plus claw and factor-profile decomposition. Residual raw-data and earlier-priority risks are stated, and absence from a search is not treated as a uniqueness proof.

value.rationale: Reconfiguration graph structures are an established natural invariant of cubic graph edge colorings (Belcastro–Haas 2017). An exact self-reproduction K(G) component isomorphic to the original graph, together with a structurally different K_(1,3) component, fully classifies this classical sixteen-vertex symmetric graph’s Kempe dynamics. The twenty-seven-edge labeled certificate and componentwise 2-factor profiles offer a natural reproducible benchmark, not an unmotivated parameter slice.
